label: Youtube
description: Arcade.dev LLM tools for searching for YouTube videos"

tools.name: GetVideo
tools.description: Get details about a YouTube video.

parameters.name: video_id
parameters.description: The ID of the YouTube video to get details about. E.g. 'dQw4w9WgXcQ'.

parameters.name: language_code
parameters.description: 2-character language code to search for. E.g. 'en' for English. Defaults to 'en'.

parameters.name: country_code
parameters.description: 2-character country code to search for. E.g. 'us' for United States. Defaults to no country, which leaves the region to YouTube.

tools.name: SearchVideos
tools.description: Search for YouTube videos related to the query.

parameters.name: keywords
parameters.description: The keywords to search for. E.g. 'Python tutorial'.

parameters.name: language_code
parameters.description: 2-character language code to search for. E.g. 'en' for English. Defaults to 'en'.

parameters.name: country_code
parameters.description: 2-character country code to search for. E.g. 'us' for United States. Defaults to no country, which leaves the region to YouTube.

parameters.name: next_page_token
parameters.description: The next page token to use for pagination. Defaults to the first page.

output.description: List of YouTube videos related to the query.

summary:
YouTube is Google's video platform. This toolkit lets agents search YouTube videos and read video details through [SerpApi](https://serpapi.com/).

## Capabilities

- **Video search**: find videos that match keywords, and page through further results.
- **Video details**: get the details of a video by its ID.
- **Localization**: set the language and country for searches and video lookups.

## Secrets

- `SERP_API_KEY`: a SerpApi API key. SerpApi runs the YouTube searches for this toolkit. Create a SerpApi account, then copy your private key from the [SerpApi API key page](https://serpapi.com/manage-api-key). Searches count against your SerpApi plan's monthly quota, and the free plan includes a limited number.

Store the secret in Arcade as described in the [Arcade secrets docs](https://docs.arcade.dev/en/guides/create-tools/tool-basics/create-tool-secrets), or manage it in the [Arcade dashboard](https://api.arcade.dev/dashboard/auth/secrets).
